description: Index one file into the user's own Tier 1 library, one batch at a time. Pass the file's text as the chatbot read it, with its SHA-256 as the idempotency key — re-indexing the same bytes is a no-op. One call carries at most 64 KiB of text; larger files are split and indexed in successive calls. This is the conversational drip path: it builds the index file by file as the user works. It cannot bootstrap a large existing library — for a library, use the browser indexer page or Local. Authentication and an active paid plan are required. The user's keyed profile (derived locally, sent per request) is also required.

content.description: The file's text, inline, as the chatbot read it. One batch carries at most 64 KiB of text (the current batch budget) — larger files are split and indexed in successive calls. This is the conversational drip path: it builds the index file by file and cannot bootstrap a large existing library. For a large library, use the browser indexer page or Local.

content_hash.description: SHA-256 of the source bytes, computed by the caller. This is the idempotency key: re-indexing the same bytes is a no-op and returns the existing result.

profile.description: The user's keyed profile, derived locally by the agent from the account key (profile_from_key_hex) and sent per request. The profile is key-equivalent: it is never stored or logged — only its fingerprint travels onward. A call without a valid profile is a 401.

source_label.description: What the user calls this material ("my research paper," "the harbor project") — the human handle, stored with the manifest.

source_name.description: The file's name as the user knows it (e.g. harbor-renovation-notes.md).

name: index
title: Index a file into the user's Tier 1 library
